text: This clip shows the owner checking a finished job and closing it.
The technician has finished the Ridgeline wrap and sent it to the owner to check. It waits on the job board, marked needs review.
The owner opens the job details and looks at the completion photos. Next to them, the estimated hours and materials sit beside what was actually used.
If something needs fixing, the owner can send it back to the technician with a note. This one looks good.
So the owner closes the job. A draft invoice is created automatically, with the deposit already taken off, ready to check before it goes out.
